incident-bot: PagerDuty: trigger PDR-4823 fired for canary-heartbeat-checker (us-west-2) — threshold breach (5m failure rate)
Sam: acked PDR-4823, I'm looking now
Alisha: pinging the oncall, any customer reports?
Sam: none in #support or metrics, purely synthetic canary spike so far
Taylor: checking grafana -> canary success drop around 2:03:10 UTC, 95th latency jump from 120ms -> 310ms
Sam: grabbing logs, running quick tail
Sam: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=canary-checker --tail=200 | rg "error|timeout" -n`
Sam: seeing a cluster of timeouts exactly during the synthetic run window, looks like scheduler overlap with a batch job
Alisha: any downstream failures? customers?
Sam: prod traffic stable, 99.9% success unchanged. this is confined to the canary pod set
Taylor: ok so low customer impact, marking P3 but we'll still suppress noise
Sam: will create a temporary silence for 10m, and add a short suppress rule for synthetic checks until we tune backoff
Sam: `/pd silence PDR-4823 10m --note "canary scheduler collision, no customer impact"`
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-4823 acknowledged by Sam
SRE-Oncall: +1 on silence, please post runbook steps you used
Sam: runbook steps: 1) ack in PD 2) mute canary route 3) confirm prod ingress stable 4) escalate if user-facing errors appear
Alisha: can you paste the exact grafana panel?
Taylor: https://grafana.company.local/d/abcd/canary-overview?from=now-15m&to=now — look at canary-1 success rate series
Sam: mute applied. suppress rule added to ignore synthetic collisions for 15m window (internal ticket will follow)
Alisha: handing monitoring to me for next 20m while Sam finishes the ticket
Sam: handing off to @Alisha for watch, I'm going to open a small follow-up to add jitter to canary scheduler
Alisha: taking watch, will post if it escalates :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-4823 auto-resolved (no further alerts)
Taylor: confirmed metrics back to normal, canary success returned to baseline by +1m
Sam: creating follow-up ticket: INF-2314 "canary scheduler jitter + backoff" with details and diffs
SRE-Oncall: noted, will pick up QoS tuning next sprint — thanks all
Alisha: closing thread, no customer impact. if anything reappears please reopen. :white_check_mark:
